content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents and read_document to inspect candidate_specs.md and any other relevant project documents. Extract the three allowed radiator candidates, their material properties, any lifetime/radiation/aging constraints, and any documented recommended or disallowed operating ranges."},{"id":"s2","description":"From the document review, eliminate any radiator candidate that cannot maintain performance over the experiment lifetime. For each remaining candidate, define an initial thickness scan covering the allowed 1 to 6 cm range, using at least 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 cm."},{"id":"s3","description":"Run simulate_separation for every non-eliminated radiator at each initial scan thickness. Record the returned pion/kaon separation values numerically for later comparison."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best-performing candidate and approximate thickness region from the initial scan. Run a finer thickness scan around the best region within 1 to 6 cm, for example in 0.25 or 0.5 cm increments, and record all separation values."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare the maximum simulated pion/kaon separation values while enforcing the document-based lifetime constraint and the 1 to 6 cm thickness constraint. Select one radiator and thickness with the highest valid separation; if results are statistically or practically tied, prefer the more lifetime-stable or operationally robust option."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Radiator-R1","thickness_cm":3,"justification":"Radiator-R1 at 3 cm gives the highest simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c among all valid scanned candidate/thickness combinations: 4.656 sigma. All three candidates remained lifetime-valid based on the project-document review, and 3 cm is within the allowed 1–6 cm thickness range.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.","status":"met","evidence":"The maximum valid simulated separation is Radiator-R1 at 3 cm with 4.656 sigma, higher than Radiator-R2's best of 3.92 sigma and Radiator-R3's best of 2.809 sigma."},{"requirement":"The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"The selected option is Radiator-R1, one of the three allowed candidates R1, R2, and R3."},{"requirement":"The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.","status":"met","evidence":"No explicit lifetime radiation/aging limits or disallowed operating ranges were found; zero candidates were eliminated for lifetime concerns, and selected_lifetime_valid = 1."},{"requirement":"Radiator thickness between 1 and 6 cm.","status":"met","evidence":"Selected thickness is 3 cm, within the allowed range of 1 to 6 cm."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted a single recommendation: Radiator-R1 at 3 cm."}]}
